eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Caddo; Canadian, OK; at 11:11 AM on SEP 15, 2026 Effective until 1:11 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
At 1303  a large and destructive wildfire was burning out of control in northern Caddo County near Scott  spreading east-northeast rapidly. Wildfires can damage or destroy structures and can harm or kill people and animals. For your safety  EVACUATE IMMEDIATELY towards State Highway 37 to the north. Those between CR 2670 and CR 2690/S Mayberry Road and SW 74th and CR 1130 should LEAVE this area NOW to avoid injury or death. Do not delay to pack belongings. 
Roads in the area may be impacted by fire and smoke. Never drive into heavy smoke. SLOW DOWN & MOVE OVER for emergency vehicles.
